fato_historico: 2016: Solar Impulse 2 becomes the first solar-powered aircraft to circumnavigate the Earth.
energia_do_dia: Today, your intense spirit may feel the call of innovation. Just as a pioneer once circled the globe using only the light of the sun, you are invited to harness your internal power to overcome obstacles. Consider this a perfect moment to let your vision expand, trusting that sustainable change often starts with a single, brilliant spark.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is the only fuel needed to circle the world.
significado_numero: Represents the harmonious balance between ambition and the journey toward success.
conselho: Trust your intuition and allow your ideas to fly without any heavy burdens.
